location_data_requirements: Actual services offered at the location
recommended_practices: Create useful location pages where justified.
Connect relevant services to actual locations.
Provide clear contact and directions information.
anti_patterns: Creating location pages for places not served
Publishing identical doorway pages for many cities
Assuming every service is available at every branch
rules: Confirm location details with the customer.
Do not create or modify external business profiles without authorization.
Do not guarantee local search rankings.
